use_case: Process-optimization model: recommends temperature profiles, addition rates, and batch end points for the 12 Blend Hall 1 reactors and the Ammonia Unit dilution skid to cut cycle time and energy
business_owner: Director of Data and Analytics (with the Port Plant Manager as process owner)
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted regression and optimization models trained on 3 years of historian data; runs in the business workloads account
data_categories: Historian process data (setpoints, temperatures, flows, analyzer results); master recipe parameters (Restricted)
affects_individuals: No (affects workers and the community only through process safety)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only: recommendations appear on a control room dashboard; operators enter any accepted change by hand within the safe operating limits; no write path to the DCS; changes outside the recipe's validated range need the shift supervisor and an MOC
applicable_laws: 40 CFR 68.69(a)(2) and 68.75 (operating limits and MOC); 29 CFR 1910.119(f), (l); C-CHEMICAL-R02 context (the model service is not a critical OT system while it has no write path; re-tier if that changes)
status: In production since 2026-03 on 4 reactors and the dilution skid; expansion paused until conditions are met

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite: drafting, summarizing, searching company files and email
business_owner: Information Security Manager (CySO) (with the IT Director)
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's assistant (large language model; vendor-hosted)
data_categories: Any content the user can reach, including over-shared SSI, formulations, and employee data
human_in_the_loop: User reviews every output; no automated actions
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 1520.9 (SSI need to know); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (employee data); vendor data-use terms
status: In production for 640 office users since 2026-01

use_case: Predictive maintenance: flags pumps, agitators, and compressors likely to fail from vibration and historian data
vendor_or_model: In-house anomaly detection model on the data platform, using a commercial analytics library
data_categories: Historian data; vibration sensor data; maintenance work orders
consequential_decision_category: None (advisory to planners; mechanical integrity inspections continue independently)
human_in_the_loop: Planners decide on work orders; the model never cancels or defers a scheduled mechanical integrity task
applicable_laws: 40 CFR 68.73 and 29 CFR 1910.119(j) (mechanical integrity stays independent of the model)
status: In production since 2025-10 (Port plant rotating equipment)

use_case: TTRS demand forecasting and automatic replenishment: forecasts each customer tank's usage and creates replenishment orders in the ERP when the forecast crosses the reorder point
vendor_or_model: In-house time-series forecasting model in the TTRS account
data_categories: Tank levels every 15 minutes; delivery history; customer site data; weather feed
human_in_the_loop: Orders are created automatically; orders above 120% of tank capacity or below the minimum load are held; dispatch reviews the next-day schedule; no human review for new tanks yet
applicable_laws: TTRS contracts and SOC 2 commitments (P09); customers' own treatment obligations depend on supply

use_case: SDS drafting assistant: drafts safety data sheet sections for new and revised formulations from the formulation and hazard data
vendor_or_model: SaaS regulatory authoring tool with a generative AI feature (vendor-hosted large language model)
affects_individuals: Yes (workers and customers who rely on SDS hazard information)
consequential_decision_category: None (a regulatory specialist decides and signs)
human_in_the_loop: A regulatory specialist reviews every draft against the hazard classification and signs before release; no automatic publication
applicable_laws: 29 CFR 1910.1200(g) (SDS content and accuracy); vendor data-use terms (no-training clause pending)
